finding: Frankie already has bounded CRITIC/LATS/ReAct/evaluator/retention/rollback and first-lock controls, but the current handoff does not define one persistent post-evidence process-level reconciliation loop.
main_risk: A meta-loop can become hindsight rationalization unless immutable first-lock bindings and next-run-only revisions are enforced mechanically.

paper_anchor.reported_core_gap: lack of a metacognitive loop that checks outputs against findings, revises when they do not hold, and questions path soundness
paper_anchor.reported_scope: 100 tasks, seven scientific domains, 800 trajectories, 45 ARFT failure patterns
paper_anchor.solution_boundary: the paper diagnoses the deficit; orchestration-level remediation is an open question, so this prototype must be treated as experimental
paper_anchor.title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks

recommended_architecture: immutable hypothesis + first-lock + evidence + result + path-trace bindings
post-evidence self-audit only; never revise the just-scored blind artifact
preserve weak/negative/sparse/inconclusive cases rather than dropping them
next-run-only revision proposal with a smallest discriminating experiment
